scenes.name: Pravrudhi-Nyaya
scenes.text: The name and its purpose land on a case-file sheet.

scenes.name: Scope and names
scenes.text: Indian law broadly with a criminal-law focus; Pravrudhi-Nyaya is the product, Prabhāsa-Nyāya our own trained models.

scenes.name: The problem
scenes.text: Fluent AI answers versus a matter that needs every ingredient shown.

scenes.name: Your facts
scenes.text: The live Screening page: the complaint split into numbered facts, the offence ticked.

scenes.name: Each ingredient
scenes.text: The live checklist: every ingredient with its status and what to check.

scenes.name: A review agenda
scenes.text: The live result on a public order: what is missing for each ingredient and what to check; ends on the standing line.

scenes.name: Two models
scenes.text: Our trained models read each ingredient; both must agree or the matter is referred.

scenes.name: Real field data
scenes.text: Built from real judgments and orders: gathered, cleaned, read by two models and checked, then divided into training, held-out testing and evaluation sets. Evaluation items are checked against training data. Real and constructed cases are labelled.

scenes.name: The formal check
scenes.text: Each offence is a formal contract; the check confirms every ingredient was addressed.

scenes.name: Nyaya discipline
scenes.text: Three Nyaya ideas that change a result: evidence you can point to, judgment withheld, testimony is checked, not trusted.

scenes.name: The pipeline
scenes.text: The seven stages light up in order, from ingest to decide.

scenes.name: Managed workflows
scenes.text: Optional managed workflows broaden the same core: the assistant proposes, the core decides.

scenes.name: What sets it apart
scenes.text: Four differences from general-purpose legal AI.

scenes.name: Privacy and cost
scenes.text: Our own models on rented GPUs; the live data-handling page; nothing is billed while idle.
